cards.name: Furhaven Orthopedic Sofa Dog Bed (Large)
cards.price: About $40–$57 for the Large at Target and PetSmart (Oct 19, 2026); Casper Large $224.10 at Target
cards.buy_if: Your dog is under about 55 lb, or older and mildly stiff, and you want a washable bed with a foam base for the price of a dinner out.
cards.skip_if: Your dog is over about 55 lb, a chewer, or a digger: the foam flattens and the cover tears. For big dogs, a Furhaven Jumbo Plus or a Big Barker (about $200–$400 depending on style, Pawleaks, Aug 2025).
cards.owners: Target, read Oct 19, 2026: 4.61 out of 5 from 387 ratings on the Large Quilted style; the 1-star reviews are about zippers that broke at the first wash and beds that arrived flat. A one-year blog test (Dec 2025) found the foam thinner under 65–70 lb dogs.
cards.video_title: ANIMAL FOSTER REVIEWS Furhaven Orthopedic Dog Bed Large Dogs
cards.video_why: An owner-style video of a Furhaven orthopedic bed on a large dog, so you can see the real size and how the foam sits; it may not be the exact style we recommend.

buy.pick: Furhaven Plush & Suede Full Support Orthopedic Sofa, Large: 36 × 27 × 6.5 in, 3-inch egg-crate base, size guide up to 55 lb
buy.check: The listing says Large (36 x 27 x 6.5 in), not Medium or Jumbo, and shows “Full Support” or egg-crate foam. Sold by Furhaven Pet or an authorized store (Furhaven's warranty goes back to the original seller). Between sizes, or over 55 lb, go to Jumbo.
